feeds.title: WIRED
feeds.description: Wired is a renowned technology and culture magazine, founded in 1993 by Louis Rossetto and Jane Metcalfe. Known for its deep dives into the impact of technology on society, Wired covers a broad spectrum of topics from science and business to design and politics. The magazine, owned by Condé Nast, features contributions from influential writers and editors such as Nicholas Thompson, its former editor-in-chief. Wired's innovative approach has earned it numerous accolades, including National Magazine Awards for General Excellence.
